donde-vivir-barcelona.html.title: Where Can I Live? · A Barcelona Housing, Commute & Neighbourhood Explorer
donde-vivir-barcelona.html.description: Filter 164 zones — 91 municipalities plus Barcelona broken into its 73 neighbourhoods — by whatever matters to you. Any of 41 measures can become a range filter with its own histogram: purchase price, rent, mortgage payment, door-to-door commute, monthly transit pass, fare zone, water price, daytime and night-time noise, density, distance to the sea, altitude, schools, green space, income, unemployment, recorded crime and more. Map, scatter, ranking and table are one linked view: hover a zone and it lights up in all four, click it for a card with a data-generated summary and percentile bars, pin up to four to compare side by side against the area median. Commute times are routed over official timetables; drop up to four named points of your own for an estimate. Nothing is invented: where a source stops publishing, the zone goes grey and the page says how many are missing and why.

sp500-rendimientos.html.title: Does the S&P 500 Really Return 10 % a Year?
sp500-rendimientos.html.description: 155 years of monthly data put the claim to the test: every calendar year, every rolling window, lump sum or monthly contributions, inflation stripped out and costs subtracted — next to gold, US housing and world equities. Shiller, FRED, Eurostat and S&P sources, nothing estimated.
